title: Fake Merc Character Study (part. 6): Slug Life
summary: Sixth installment of NH's monthly mocking 'character study' of YouTuber Jason Blaha, whom he accuses of hiding fat with a belt and corset, posing tricks, sock-puppet accounts, political flip-flopping, a fabricated mercenary past and a failed ASMR channel. He argues Blaha's poor physique is self-inflicted through drug use and refusal to train for bodybuilding rather than purely genetic.
claims: He alleges Blaha wears a lifting belt on every exercise while shirtless to compress his waist and fake a better V-taper, a trick he says many bodybuilders use
Pressing the arms against a desk while tensing makes the triceps, biceps and forearms look bigger and leaner, like pressing the lat against the triceps in a pose
He claims women prefer big arms over big legs almost every time, and that men who claim otherwise are reinventing attractiveness to fit their own bodies
He alleges Blaha invented a clandestine mercenary background, a typical fraud tactic because a secret past cannot be disproven
Doing three hours of slow stationary biking while gaming and still staying obese shows a minimal-effort approach that ignores what actually works
He is pro no-cuts raw footage, but thousands of unedited repetitive videos are regurgitated content
Fitness coaching on YouTube is hard to make a living from unless you have a lot of visibility and can prove you lift

Genetics matter less than people think: he himself has a narrow frame, small shoulders and a wide waist, yet built a good physique, whereas a bad physique can be self-inflicted by early drug use and refusing to train
A strength athlete should be able to talk for 40 minutes without getting out of breath; constant breathlessness signals poor cardiovascular health
